|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">帝国軍ストームトルーパーの標準支給品。ロープやフックなど、さまざまな緊急用品を装備する。反乱軍は、帝国軍から奪ったこの万能ベルトを自分たちで使用していた。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Stormtrooper Utility Belt.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Imperial or alien. The character is power and forfeit +1. On the Death Star, the bonus is +2 instead.

'''Lore:''' Standard issue for Imperial stormtroopers, carrying rope, hooks, and other emergency supplies. Rebels used belts they captured from the Empire.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' On the [[Death Star]] the Japanese prints +2 instead of +1; the English prints +2.
